name: self-measuring-mcp
description: Deterministic, Ed25519-signed self-measurement for AI agents. An agent calls self_measure on its own metrics and receives a verifiable card (license, provenance/Art 50 marking, logging, oversight, openness) it can present to a CI gate, marketplace, or insurer.

capabilities.description: Emit a signed measurement card for the caller's own metrics
Detect drift vs a prior signed state
